candidates.name: Zuluf Field-Ju'aymah Oil Trunklines
aka: Zuluf AH Crude Oil Increment Project pipelines
Zuluf Oilfield Expansion Offshore/Onshore Oil Trunklines (CRPO 79)
candidates.from: Zuluf offshore field / onshore central processing facility (Tanajib area)

evidence.note: Reports McDermott in line for the CRPO 79 package on Aramco's Zuluf offshore expansion, part of a trio of offshore contracts worth upwards of $500 million.

Tender/contract listing for 'Oil Trunklines & Power Cables Installation Project - Zuluf Offshore Field Development (CRPO 79)'; scope per trade press covering this package: two 42-inch oil trunklines (east and west) plus a 42-inch water-injection line, onshore and offshore, tying the Zuluf development into the export/processing chain.

Confirms the Zuluf expansion (600,000 b/d Arabian Heavy increment, Saudi Aramco-operated) includes new downstream pipelines carrying stabilized crude from the onshore central processing facility to the Ju'aymah crude oil terminal, with gas/condensate routed separately to the Tanajib gas plant.

Confirms the Zuluf crude oil increment project (600,000 b/d central processing facility) was still in active EPC as of Q2 2024, targeting completion around 2026 -- i.e. still under construction, not yet the retired 2020 original schedule.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row carries 'Zuluf' in Name/OtherNames. The roster's Juaymah-terminal family (P1958 Safaniyah-Juaymah, P1987/P1988/P1989 Qatif Junction-Juaymah, P1970 Abu Ali-Berri junction, P1978 Berri junction-Ras Tanura) shows GEM already tracks individual field/junction-to-terminal oil trunklines at this granularity -- this Zuluf-to-Ju'aymah trunkline (2x 42-in, onshore+offshore, CRPO 79) fits the same pattern but has no corresponding row. Possible it is loosely covered by no existing PID; closest analogues by pattern are P1958 and the P1987-1989 family, but none match Zuluf as an endpoint or alias.
